list_child.name: list_agreements
list_child.desc: This tool returns the full list of rental agreements currently on file, spanning every renter and every vehicle. It is the right starting point whenever a broad view of the fleet's rental activity is needed.

get_child.name: get_agreement
get_child.desc: This tool fetches the complete details of a single rental agreement identified by its id. It includes the vehicle description, current stage, and the scheduled return time.

list_parent.name: list_renters
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every renter who has an account on file with the rental company, including their contact information. It is typically used before looking up a particular renter's own record.

get_parent.name: get_renter
get_parent.desc: This tool retrieves one renter's full record by their renter id. Use it once the renter's id has already been identified through the renter listing tool.

delete_child.name: purge_agreement
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a rental agreement record from the system, and the deletion cannot be reversed. It should be reserved for agreements that truly need to be wiped rather than simply cancelled.

set_enum.name: set_agreement_stage
set_enum.desc: This tool updates a rental agreement's stage among reserved, active, returned, or cancelled. It should be used any time the real-world status of a rental changes and needs to be reflected in the system.

set_bool.name: flag_damage
set_bool.desc: This tool marks a rental agreement's vehicle as having been returned with damage. It is used by staff during vehicle inspection at the time of return.

set_ref.name: reassign_renter
set_ref.desc: This tool transfers a rental agreement from one renter's account to a different renter entirely. It is used when an agreement was created under the wrong renter and needs correcting.

send.name: email_renter
send.desc: This tool sends an email directly to a renter using the address on file. It is typically used to reach a renter about the status of their rental agreement.
